secondary.title: The Gutenberg Bible: Landmark of the Western World
secondary.author: Various
secondary.rationale: While slightly before the 1976 cutoff, this is a seminal work often cited in Gutenberg scholarship, focusing on his most famous achievement. It's a foundational text for understanding his legacy.

suggestions.notes: Primary sources directly authored by Johannes Gutenberg are extremely rare and not readily available in digitized formats on common platforms like Wikisource or Project Gutenberg. His significant contributions were primarily through his inventions and the products of his press, rather than extensive written works attributed to him personally.
